# Murto Hilali

> {{ site.description }}

Personal site and portfolio of Murto Hilali, a Biotech and Economics student at
the University of Waterloo. The writing is mostly computational biology and
machine learning applied to proteins — contact maps, binding-site prediction,
structure-based drug discovery — with occasional detours into tools, business,
and travel.

Posts are long-form technical write-ups: each project post walks through the
full pipeline, including the dead ends, and links the repo and dataset where
they exist.

## Pages
